perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, the available information is:

- SEEKER asked for good new science fiction film recommendations, preferably already on DVD or available to rent/watch online.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER suggest *Star Wars: The Force Awakens* (2015).
- SEEKER had already seen *Star Wars: The Force Awakens* and said so, joking that everyone has.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER mention *Passengers* (2016) with Jennifer Lawrence and Chris Pratt.
- SEEKER had not seen *Passengers* and asked what it was about.
- SEEKER was told *Passengers* is about a guy, Pratt, who is awakened prematurely on an interstellar space trip and wakes up another passenger, Lawrence, for company; meanwhile the ship is in danger of falling apart and they have to figure out why.
- SEEKER said *Passengers* sounded melodramatic.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER agree it is melodramatic but still call it an okay movie.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER suggest *Life* (2017) with Jake Gyllenhaal and Ryan Reynolds, described as a dark film about an alien life form from Mars.
- SEEKER said *Life* sounded more his speed.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER then suggest *The Thing* (2011), saying it is not a remake of the original but a prequel about what happened to the Norwegians before the dog shows up at the US camp.
- SEEKER said he never watched *The Thing* because he thought it was a remake of the original.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER say it is not a remake and is an entirely different story.
- SEEKER heard RECOMMENDER also suggest *Pandorum* (2009) with Dennis Quaid and Ben Foster, described as very similar to *Passengers* but much darker and with no romance.
- SEEKER has no other information beyond this conversation and his prior viewing of *Star Wars: The Force Awakens*.
